title: AI-Powered Space Optimization for Low-Income Housing
summary: VIT is testing space optimization on synthetic and reference floor plans. Improved living space and construction outcomes remain prospective.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: VIT is prototyping space optimization with synthetic and reference floor plans. Improved living space and construction outcomes remain prospective.
purpose: Improve usable space in small and low-income homes.

ratings.reason: Low-income residents are intended to obtain more usable living space.
Housing authorities are intended to improve layouts; no built-project outcome is supplied.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 11: AI-Powered Space Optimization for Low-Income Housing

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Reference floor plans and layout constraints

headline: AI optimizes layouts for low-income housing
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
